## Problem / motivation
What problem are you trying to solve? What is the use case?

## Proposed solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen (e.g. a new command,
flag, platform, or output format).

## Alternatives considered
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional context
Links, examples, or references (e.g. a platform's API docs) that would help.
